verses.en: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
verses.pt: Depois disto Paulo partiu para Atenas e chegou a Corinto.
verses.en_web: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth.
verses.en_bbe: After these things, he went away from Athens, and came to Corinth.

verses.en: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.
verses.pt: E encontrando um judeu por nome Áqüila, natural do Ponto, que pouco antes viera da Itália, e Priscila, sua mulher (porque Cláudio tinha decretado que todos os judeus saíssem de Roma), foi ter com eles,
verses.en_web: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,
verses.en_bbe: And there he came across a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by birth, who not long before had come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had given orders that all Jews were to go away from Rome: and he came to them;

verses.en: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.
verses.pt: e, por ser do mesmo ofício, com eles morava, e juntos trabalhavam; pois eram, por ofício, fabricantes de tendas.
verses.en_web: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.
verses.en_bbe: And because he was of the same trade, he was living with them, and they did their work together; for by trade they were tent-makers.

verses.en: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.
verses.pt: Ele discutia todos os sábados na sinagoga, e persuadia a judeus e gregos.
verses.en_web: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath, and persuaded Jews and Greeks.
verses.en_bbe: And every Sabbath he had discussions in the Synagogue, turning Jews and Greeks to the faith.

verses.en: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.
verses.pt: Quando Silas e Timóteo desceram da Macedônia, Paulo dedicou- se inteiramente à palavra, testificando aos judeus que Jesus era o Cristo.
verses.en_web: But when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was completely given up to the word, preaching to the Jews that the Christ was Jesus.

verses.en: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.
verses.pt: Como estes, porém, se opusessem e proferissem injúrias, sacudiu ele as vestes e disse-lhes: O vosso sangue seja sobre a vossa cabeça; eu estou limpo, e desde agora vou para os gentios.
verses.en_web: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”
verses.en_bbe: And when they put themselves against him, and said evil words, he said, shaking his clothing, Your blood be on your heads, I am clean: from now I will go to the Gentiles.

verses.en: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man’s house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
verses.pt: E saindo dali, entrou em casa de um homem temente a Deus, chamado Tito Justo, cuja casa ficava junto da sinagoga.
verses.en_web: He departed there, and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.
verses.en_bbe: And moving from there, he went into the house of a man named Titus Justus, a God-fearing man, whose house was very near the Synagogue.

verses.en: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.
verses.pt: Crispo, chefe da sinagoga, creu no Senhor com toda a sua casa; e muitos dos coríntios, ouvindo, criam e eram batizados.
verses.en_web: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.
verses.en_bbe: And Crispus, the ruler of the Synagogue, with all his family, had faith in the Lord; and a great number of the people of Corinth, hearing the word, had faith and were given baptism.

verses.en: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
verses.pt: E de noite disse o Senhor em visão a Paulo: Não temas, mas fala e não te cales;
verses.en_web: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Paul in the night, in a vision, Have no fear and go on preaching:

verses.en: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
verses.pt: porque eu estou contigo e ninguém te acometerá para te fazer mal, pois tenho muito povo nesta cidade.
verses.en_web: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
verses.en_bbe: For I am with you, and no one will make an attack on you to do you damage: for I have a number of people in this town.

verses.en: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
verses.pt: E ficou ali um ano e seis meses, ensinando entre eles a palavra de Deus.
verses.en_web: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
verses.en_bbe: And he was there for a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

verses.en: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,
verses.pt: Sendo Gálio procônsul da Acaia, levantaram-se os judeus de comum acordo contra Paulo, e o levaram ao tribunal,
verses.en_web: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,
verses.en_bbe: But when Gallio was ruler of Achaia, all the Jews together made an attack on Paul, and took him to the judge's seat,

verses.en: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
verses.pt: dizendo: Este persuade os homens a render culto a Deus de um modo contrário à lei.
verses.en_web: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, This man is teaching the people to give worship to God in a way which is against the law.

verses.en: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
verses.pt: E, quando Paulo estava para abrir a boca, disse Gálio aos judeus: Se de fato houvesse, ó judeus, algum agravo ou crime perverso, com razão eu vos sofreria;
verses.en_web: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;
verses.en_bbe: But when Paul was about to say something, Gallio said to the Jews, If this was anything to do with wrongdoing or crime, there would be a reason for me to give you a hearing:

verses.en: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.
verses.pt: mas, se são questões de palavras, de nomes, e da vossa lei, disso cuidai vós mesmos; porque eu não quero ser juiz destas coisas.
verses.en_web: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”
verses.en_bbe: But if it is a question of words or names or of your law, see to it yourselves; I will not be a judge of such things.

verses.en: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
verses.pt: E expulsou-os do tribunal.
verses.en_web: So he drove them from the judgment seat.
verses.en_bbe: And he sent them away from the judge's seat.

verses.en: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
verses.pt: Então todos agarraram Sóstenes, chefe da sinagoga, e o espancavam diante do tribunal; e Gálio não se importava com nenhuma dessas coisas.
verses.en_web: Then all the Greeks laid hold on Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.
verses.en_bbe: And they all made an attack on Sosthenes, the ruler of the Synagogue, and gave him blows before the judge's seat; but Gallio gave no attention to these things.

verses.en: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
verses.pt: Paulo, tendo ficado ali ainda muitos dias, despediu-se dos irmãos e navegou para a Síria, e com ele Priscila e Áqüila, havendo rapado a cabeça em Cencréia, porque tinha voto.
verses.en_web: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.
verses.en_bbe: And Paul, after waiting some days, went away from the brothers and went by ship to Syria, Priscilla and Aquila being with him; and he had had his hair cut off in Cenchrea, for he had taken an oath.

verses.en: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
verses.pt: E eles chegaram a Éfeso, onde Paulo os deixou; e tendo entrado na sinagoga, discutia com os judeus.
verses.en_web: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
verses.en_bbe: And they came down to Ephesus and he left them there: and he himself went into the Synagogue and had a discussion with the Jews.

verses.en: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;
verses.pt: Estes rogavam que ficasse por mais algum tempo, mas ele não anuiu,
verses.en_web: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;
verses.en_bbe: And being requested by them to be there for a longer time, he said, No;

verses.en: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.
verses.pt: antes se despediu deles, dizendo: Se Deus quiser, de novo voltarei a vós; e navegou de Éfeso.
verses.en_web: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.
verses.en_bbe: And went from them, saying, I will come back to you if God lets me; and he took ship from Ephesus.

verses.en: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
verses.pt: Tendo chegado a Cesaréia, subiu a Jerusalém e saudou a igreja, e desceu a Antioquia.
verses.en_web: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had come to land at Caesarea, he went to see the church, and then went down to Antioch.

verses.en: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
verses.pt: E, tendo demorado ali algum tempo, partiu, passando sucessivamente pela região da Galácia e da Frígia, fortalecendo a todos os discípulos.
verses.en_web: Having spent some time there, he departed, and went through the region of Galatia, and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.
verses.en_bbe: And having been there for some time, he went through the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, making the disciples strong in the faith.

verses.en: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
verses.pt: Ora, chegou a Éfeso certo judeu chamado Apolo, natural de Alexandria, homem eloqüente e poderoso nas Escrituras.
verses.en_web: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.
verses.en_bbe: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by birth, and a man of learning, came to Ephesus; and he had great knowledge of the holy Writings.

verses.en: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.
verses.pt: Era ele instruído no caminho do Senhor e, sendo fervoroso de espírito, falava e ensinava com precisão as coisas concernentes a Jesus, conhecendo entretanto somente o batismo de João.
verses.en_web: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.
verses.en_bbe: This man had been trained in the way of the Lord; and burning in spirit, he gave himself up to teaching the facts about Jesus, though he had knowledge only of John's baptism:

verses.en: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.
verses.pt: Ele começou a falar ousadamente na sinagoga: mas quando Priscila e Áqüila o ouviram, levaram-no consigo e lhe expuseram com mais precisão o caminho de Deus.
verses.en_web: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
verses.en_bbe: And he was preaching in the Synagogue without fear. But Priscilla and Aquila, hearing his words, took him in, and gave him fuller teaching about the way of God.

verses.en: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:
verses.pt: Querendo ele passar à Acáia, os irmãos o animaram e escreveram aos discípulos que o recebessem; e tendo ele chegado, auxiliou muito aos que pela graça haviam crido.
verses.en_web: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him, and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;
verses.en_bbe: And when he had a desire to go over into Achaia, the brothers gave him help, and sent letters to the disciples requesting them to take him in among them: and when he had come, he gave much help to those who had faith through grace:

verses.en: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.
verses.pt: Pois com grande poder refutava publicamente os judeus, demonstrando pelas escrituras que Jesus era o Cristo.
verses.en_web: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For he overcame the Jews in public discussion, making clear from the holy Writings that the Christ was Jesus.
